topic: Visitors next week, rumours this week
title_jp: {職員室|しょくいんしつ}の{噂|うわさ}
context: Wednesday 6 January: the school holidays aren't over, but {佐藤|さとう}{先生|せんせい} asks アルちゃん into the staff room at {鷹ノ原高校|たかのはらこうこう}. She passes on news from the vice principal, and a rumour from the students.
scene: Still the holidays. {佐藤|さとう}{先生|せんせい} has called you into the staff room with news, and with something she heard from the students.

phrases.jp: {急ぐ|いそぐ|to hurry|4}ことはないよ。ゆっくりでいい。
phrases.en: There's no need to hurry. Take your time.
phrases.note: Reassuring a friend or a kid. Polite: {急|いそ}ぐことはありません.

phrases.jp: {聞いた|きいた}{話|はなし}では、{今年|ことし}は{雪|ゆき}が{多い|おおい}そうです。
phrases.en: From what I've heard, there'll be a lot of snow this year.
phrases.note: {聞|き}いた{話|はなし}では opens hearsay; end with そうです.

phrases.jp: お{休み|やすみ}の{日|ひ}に{呼び出して|よびだして|to call someone in|3}、すみません。
phrases.en: Sorry to call you in on your day off.

phrases.jp: {わざわざ||going to the trouble|3}{来る|くる}ことはなかったのに。
phrases.en: You didn't have to come all this way.
phrases.note: Past ことはなかった + のに: gently 'there was no need'. Warm, not a complaint.

phrases.jp: {授業|じゅぎょう}を{見学|けんがく|observing, a study visit|3}させていただけますか。
phrases.note: Humble request: させていただけますか = may I be allowed to.

dialogue_setting: The staff room ({職員室|しょくいんしつ}) of {鷹ノ原高校|たかのはらこうこう}, nearly empty, the heater humming. New Year greetings have just been exchanged.

dialogue.speaker: 佐藤先生
dialogue.jp: {早速|さっそく|right away, without delay|3}ですが、{教頭|きょうとう|vice principal|2}{先生|せんせい}によると、{来週|らいしゅう}、{教育委員会|きょういくいいんかい|board of education|2}の{方|かた}が{見学|けんがく|observing, a study visit|3}に{来られる|こられる}そうです。
dialogue.en: Straight to business: according to the vice principal, someone from the board of education is coming to observe next week.
dialogue.note: {来|こ}られる here is respectful (= いらっしゃる), not 'can come'.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: えっ、{僕|ぼく}の{授業|じゅぎょう}もですか？スーツを{着て|きて}きたほうがいいでしょうか。
dialogue.en: What, my class too? Should I come in a suit?

dialogue.speaker: 佐藤先生
dialogue.jp: いいえ、{特別|とくべつ|special|4}な{準備|じゅんび|preparation|4}をすることはありません。{いつも通り|いつもどおり|as usual|4}で{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}ですよ。
dialogue.en: No, there's no need to prepare anything special. Just as usual is fine.

dialogue.speaker: 佐藤先生
dialogue.jp: それと、{生徒|せいと}から{聞いた|きいた}んですが、アルちゃんに{長野|ながの}の{彼女|かのじょ}がいるって{噂|うわさ|rumour|3}があるらしいですね。
dialogue.en: Also, I heard from the students: apparently there's a rumour you have a girlfriend in {長野|ながの}.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: えっ、{学校|がっこう}にまで{広まって|ひろまって|to spread|3}るんですか…。{何て|なんて}{答えたら|こたえたら}いいでしょう。
dialogue.en: What, it's spread all the way to school? What should I tell them?
dialogue.note: {広|ひろ}まってる = {広|ひろ}まっている, dropping い in speech.

dialogue.speaker: 佐藤先生
dialogue.jp: {無理に|むりに|forcibly, against your will|3}{答える|こたえる}ことはありませんよ。「{秘密|ひみつ|secret|4}です」で{十分|じゅうぶん|enough|4}です。
dialogue.en: You don't have to answer if you'd rather not. 'It's a secret' is quite enough.

listening.intro: As you're leaving, the staff-room speaker comes on.
listening.title: {職員室|しょくいんしつ}の{放送|ほうそう}
listening.place: {鷹ノ原高校|たかのはらこうこう}

lines.jp: {先生方|せんせいがた}にお{知らせ|しらせ}します。{本日|ほんじつ|today (formal)|3}の{打ち合わせ|うちあわせ|meeting, briefing|3}は、2{時|じ}から{和室|わしつ|Japanese-style room|3}で{行います|おこないます}。
lines.en: A notice for teachers. Today's meeting will be held from 2 o'clock in the Japanese-style room.

lines.jp: {会議室|かいぎしつ}ではありませんので、ご{注意|ちゅうい}ください。
lines.en: Please note: not in the meeting room.

listening.question: {打ち合わせ|うちあわせ}は、どこでありますか。
listening.explain: {和室|わしつ} = the tatami room. The second line warns it's not the usual {会議室|かいぎしつ}.

grammar.form: {動詞|どうし}{辞書形|じしょけい}: + ことはない ({急|いそ}ぐ → {急|いそ}ぐことはない, する → することはない) · polite: + ことはありません ({答|こた}える → {答|こた}えることはありません) · past: + ことはなかった ({来|く}る → {来|く}ることはなかった)
grammar.explanation: Tells someone an action isn't necessary, usually to reassure them: 'no need to worry'. It sounds warmer and firmer than 〜なくてもいい. It always follows the dictionary form, never the ない-form.
mark: 答えることはありません
することはありません
買うことはありません

examples.jp: {謝る|あやまる|to apologise|4}ことはないよ。{誰|だれ}でも{間違える|まちがえる|to make a mistake|4}から。
examples.en: No need to apologise. Everyone makes mistakes.

examples.jp: {高い|たかい}{靴|くつ}を{買う|かう}ことはありません。{長靴|ながぐつ|rubber boots|3}で{十分|じゅうぶん|enough|4}です。
examples.en: There's no need to buy expensive shoes. Rubber boots are plenty.

quiz.question: {心配|しんぱい}＿＿ことはないよ。すぐ{慣れる|なれる|to get used to|3}から。
quiz.en: No need to worry. You'll soon get used to it.
quiz.explain: ことはない follows the dictionary form: {心配|しんぱい}することはない.

quiz_more.question: {大雪|おおゆき|heavy snow|3}だから、{今日|きょう}は{無理|むり}して{来る|くる}＿＿。
quiz_more.en: It's snowing heavily, so there's no need to force yourself to come today.
quiz_more.explain: ことはありません = no need. ことがあります means 'sometimes happens'.

quiz_more.question: {電話|でんわ}でよかったのに。{わざわざ||going to the trouble|3}{来る|くる}＿＿のに。
quiz_more.en: A phone call would have done. You didn't have to come all this way.
quiz_more.explain: They already came, so use the past: ことはなかったのに.

kanji.where: A label on the slipper rack at the school entrance, where you change out of your snow boots.
kanji.breakdown: {来客|らいきゃく}: 来 come + 客 guest → a visitor; 用 'for use by' → 'for visitors'.
kanji.related: {職員用|しょくいんよう} = for staff.

tip.title: In and out of the staff room
tip.body: Say 「{失礼|しつれい}します」 as you enter a {職員室|しょくいんしつ} and 「{失礼|しつれい}しました」 as you leave, even if nobody looks up. Shoes stay at the entrance: visitors take the {来客用|らいきゃくよう} slippers, and you put them back neatly.

challenge.prompt: {恵子|けいこ}さん: 「{見学|けんがく|observing, a study visit|3}の{日|ひ}、{主人|しゅじん}のスーツ{貸そうか|かそうか}？」 Thank her, and pass on that there's apparently no need to wear one.
pieces: ありがとうございます。
challenge.model_answer: ありがとうございます。でも、スーツを{着る|きる}ことはないそうです。
challenge.explanation: {着|き}る (dictionary form) + ことはない = no need to wear. Adding そうです after ない passes it on as something you heard from {佐藤|さとう}{先生|せんせい}. ございます keeps it polite for {恵子|けいこ}さん.
challenge.hint: ことはない, then そうです for hearsay

vocab.note: {早速|さっそく}ですが = 'to get straight to it', a polite way into business.
Called {教頭|きょうとう}{先生|せんせい}. The principal is {校長|こうちょう}{先生|せんせい}.
{見|み} see + {学|がく} learn. {工場見学|こうじょうけんがく} = factory tour.
な-adjective: {特別|とくべつ}な{日|ひ}. Adverb: {特別|とくべつ}に.
Noun + {通|どお}り = just like: {予定通|よていどお}り, as planned.
{急|いそ}いで！ = hurry up! {急|きゅう}に = suddenly.
{呼|よ}ぶ call + {出|だ}す out. Also being called to the teacher's office.
Often thanking: わざわざありがとう = thanks for going to the trouble.

kanji_study.parts: 口 mouth + 乎 (a sound of breath leaving) → breath coming out of the mouth: to call out, to breathe.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 平 (flat): 呼 has 口 on the left and a hooked stroke at the bottom.

kanji_study.parts: 禾 a stalk of grain + 口 mouth → a mouth with food (rice): everyone fed and at peace. Harmony, and by extension 'Japanese'.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 私 (I, private): 私 has the hook ム on the right, 和 has 口.
